Get trained only in what you want!

Our Coaching

The Best

Our trainers are widely regarded as the best trainers available anywhere in India. With top notch certifications from Cambridge, including GRADE A scores in tests like the CPE (the most advanced English language exam conducted by the Universty of Cambridge) you can be assured of training that is unparalleled.

Are you really the best?

Yes. Here's why.

First Academy is the best choice for your coaching needs because you are trained by authors of English test-preparation books. They have extensive knowledge and experience in preparing students for international exams, and their teaching methods and materials are specifically designed to help students succeed in the test.

What more do I get?

You get a lot more.

In addition to what has been said above, First Academy also offers a range of other resources and support to help you prepare for the test. These include a full-fledged preparation portal with mock tests, personalized study plans, and one-on-one sessions that will tell you where exactly you need to improve.

I do not believe you?

Good. You should see it for yourself before you believe it.

Our sessions are the best and we are ready to take that challenge. Attend a session for free and interact with our trainers and other students. Enroll with us only if you feel these sessions are worth your time! We are absolutely sure you will love them! Or, you could simply take a Free Test and see how our evaluation is!

Loved by students and professionals across the globe.

Questions about Personalised training

Here are a few questions about our personalised training that people usually want to know the answers to. If your question isn’t answered here, you can always contact Usand we will answer it for you!

Is it only online? + −

No! Our personalised sessions are available both online and offline! We would be delighted to arrange for a personal session for you at our premises. We will help you chart a plan and a timetable too!

I want to be training only in one module. Is that possible? + −

Absolutely! The whole purpose of personalised training is that. You can choose which sections you attend and when!

I live in another country, can I train with you? + −

Oh yeah! 😀 We have had people from Australia, Morocco, Iran, Nigeria, and several other places come to us for training. If you wish to visit India for our training, we welcome you with unfettered delight. If you wish to train online, we can do that too! Let us help you get started!

Do I have to pay the full fee? + −

If you wish to take up the classroom training for only one of the modules, you will not be paying the full fee. You will however be receiving the full set of material and access to the lab for the duration of your training! If you want to take up individual training, we will tailor the course and give you full details of the fee before you start the course.

I am still not sure! What do I do? + −

Call us, or visit us. We will always be ready to assist you! And talking to us is free. If you have a question about the test, we would love to answer it!
